title: LogitGate: Probe-Gated Output Logit Bias as a Simplification of Activation Steering for Tool Calling

contributions.purpose: 让 activation steering 收益在无 mid-layer hook 框架可用
contributions.mechanism: probe-gated 三值门控从中间层搬到输出 logit 层
contributions.evaluation: BFCL + Qwen2.5-1.5B,恢复 ASA 80.7% Trigger-F1 增益,FPR 持平 0.0833
contributions.source_quote: We introduce LogitGate, a method that replaces mid-layer activation steering with decode-time logit bias...

contributions.mechanism: K=1 首 token 偏置消融
contributions.evaluation: K=1 足够,支持 boundary calibration 假说
contributions.source_quote: We show that K=1 (first-token bias only) is sufficient...
We provide ablation studies confirming that the probe-guided gate is essential for FPR control...

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work bridges activation steering and constrained decoding. LogitGate adopts the probe-guided gating mechanism from ASA but applies intervention at the output logit level rather than mid-layer

notes: pilot 手工抽取;预判 Recombination(mechanism 搬迁)
